title: How to Make a Party Interesting

cards.answer: A yearly night hangout in an Airbnb with deep talks to get to know each other better.

cards.prompt: Which activity was NOT planned for the meetup?
cards.answer: Karaoke was deliberately cut because the group prefers non-exaggerated activities.

cards.prompt: Why does the plan have a coffee counter instead of cocktails?
cards.answer: The event deliberately has no cocktails; coffee is the drink option.

cards.prompt: Order the first activities of the meetup night.
cards.answer: Starts with dinner, then ice breaking, sharing session, then barbecue.

cards.prompt: What is the purpose of the ice breaking activity?
cards.answer: To throw random funny questions to anyone so everyone gets to know each other.
